name: Welcome Tutorial
description: Get started with the dGuild platform

steps.title: Welcome to Your dGuild Castle!
steps.description: Welcome to your dGuild castle! You're about to experience a dGuild in operation and explore what the platform has to offer. This tutorial will guide you through the basics of navigating your guild and completing your first quest.

steps.title: Navigate to Solo Quests
steps.description: Click on the "Quest Board" in the Castle, then select "Solo Quests" from the sub-menu to jump right into it.
steps.action: Navigate to Quest Board > Solo Quests

steps.title: Sign Up for Tutorial Quest
steps.description: Find the "Tutorial Quest: Ammo Delivery" and click the sign-up button to join your first quest! This quest will teach you the basics of quest completion.
